attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Office of Professional Licensure and Certification – Speech-Language Pathology / Hearing Care Providers Governing Boards

rules.accepted_credit_types: No pre-approval needed and no delivery-method restriction. Academic instruction (credits as assigned), courses/seminars/conferences/workshops (1 clock hour = 1 CE), ASHA convention events, facility in-service incl. grand rounds, webinars/video courses (credits as assigned), CPR certification (4 CE), infection control (max 2 CE), journal study (12 CE, max 12), employer-required training (max 2 CE), article publication (12 CE), presentations (2 CE per hour, max 8), research project (12 CE), product development (4 CE), teaching (2 CE per hour, max 8).
rules.new_licensee_rule: No different requirements for the first renewal (per OPLC table).
rules.audit_note: 10% of licensees audited (Plc 308.04(d)). Since Nov 1, 2024 licensees must track CE in CE Broker.
rules.notes: At least 15 of the 30 hours must relate directly to the clinical application of speech-language pathology; the rest to general SLP theory and practice (subject areas: clinical, SLP theory, supervision, consultation, SLP education/curriculum, trans-disciplinary issues). CE cycle = 2-year license term. Numbers from the OPLC summary table; full rules in N.H. Admin. Rules Spe 400.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Spe 401, Spe 405; Plc 308.04
rules.rule_quote: License Type: Speech Language Pathologist CE Hours Total=30 hours At least 15 hours shall relate directly to the clinical application of speech language pathology Remaining hours shall relate to general speech language pathology theory and practice CE Cycle 2 years…

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses must be Board-approved: college/university courses and programs offered or accredited by AADA, AAA, ASHA, AMA, American Academy of Otolaryngology, International Hearing Society or organizations credentialed by them are automatically approved; others need Board pre-approval (Hcp 402.03, via CE Broker). Credit = 60-minute hour of participation (Hcp 402.01).
